fusions.name: Spoken Bolt
fusions.desc: Speaks a bolt of wind into being that strikes the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Hushing Word
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 7 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 9 damage, taking its next action away and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Quickened Diction
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Practised Cadence
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
